consultation.heading: Ask once. Get the law behind it.
consultation.body: Every consultation streams in as it's written, with related case law listed beside it — title, case or R.A. number, source link, and an excerpt, with vetted citations marked. Attach a document and the assistant searches inside it once indexing finishes.

firms.heading: Built for how firms actually work
firms.teamsBody: Practise solo, or create a firm on one of three plans — Solo, Professional, Enterprise — and invite colleagues by email with a role: Owner, Admin, or Member. Every destructive step asks for confirmation first, and an owner names a successor before they can leave.
